targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "strings"
alerts = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 1h, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and r.env == "${source}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "severity" or r._field == "ues_total" or r._field == "rep_value"
      or r._field == "rep_key" or r._field == "reason")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({alert_id: r.alert_id, rule: r.rule, stage: r.stage, kind: r.kind, cell: r.cell, event: r.event,
      t: r._time, f: r._field, s: string(v: r._value), a: true}))
  |> group()
evidence = alerts |> filter(fn: (r) => false)
summary = union(tables: [alerts, evidence])
  |> group(columns: ["alert_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["t"])
  |> reduce(identity: {rule: "", stage: "", kind: "", cell: "", start: time(v: 0), last: time(v: 0), active: time(v: 0),
                       event: "", sev: 0, ues: "", rep: "", key: "", reason: "", n: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        rule: if r.a then r.rule else accumulator.rule,
        stage: if r.a then r.stage else accumulator.stage,
        kind: if r.a then r.kind else accumulator.kind,
        cell: if r.a then r.cell else accumulator.cell,
        start: if r.a and accumulator.n == 0 then r.t else accumulator.start,
        last: if r.a then r.t else accumulator.last,
        active: if r.t > accumulator.active then r.t else accumulator.active,
        event: if r.a then r.event else accumulator.event,
        sev: if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "high" then 2
             else if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "medium" and accumulator.sev < 1 then 1 else accumulator.sev,
        ues: if r.f == "ues_total" then r.s else accumulator.ues,
        rep: if r.f == "rep_value" then r.s else accumulator.rep,
        key: if r.f == "rep_key" then r.s else accumulator.key,
        reason: if r.f == "reason" then r.s else accumulator.reason,
        n: if r.a then accumulator.n + 1 else accumulator.n}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.n > 0)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      idle = int(v: now()) - int(v: r.active)
      limit = if r.stage == "1" then 15000000000 else 90000000000
      return {r with
        status: if r.event == "clear" then "해제" else if r.event == "end" then "강제 종료 (" + r.reason + ")"
                else if idle > limit then "상태 불명" else "열림",
        class: if r.kind == "attack" then "공격" else if strings.hasPrefix(v: r.rule, prefix: "AN-") then "이상 유형" else "판정 보류"}
    })

in_range = summary
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.start >= v.timeRangeStart and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
counted = in_range
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({alert_id: r.alert_id, class: r.class, _value: 1}))
  |> keep(columns: ["class", "_value"])
zeros = array.from(rows: [{class: "공격", _value: 0}, {class: "이상 유형", _value: 0}, {class: "판정 보류", _value: 0}])
union(tables: [counted, zeros])
  |> group(columns: ["class"])
  |> sum()

panels.title: 단계 비교 — 1~4단계 vs 1단계만
panels.description: 표준 KPM(1단계)만으로는 못 잡고 UE 메시지(2~4단계)로 잡은 경보가 몇 개인가 — 프로젝트 핵심 주장. 같은 기록을 1단계만으로 다시 재생한 결과(위쪽 '단계 비교 대상', 기본 replay-kpm-only — 탐지 쪽이 detector --replay로 만들어 보냄, 27_ §3)와 룰별 경보 수를 비교해, 1~4단계가 더 많은 만큼을 더한다. 재생 결과가 없으면 '재생 없음'

targets.query:
import "array"
count_raises = (env) => from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and r._field == "severity" and r.event == "raise" and r.env == env
      and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["rule"])
  |> count()
full = count_raises(env: "${source}") |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, s: "full", _value: r._value}))
kpm = count_raises(env: "${kpm_only}") |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, s: "kpm", _value: r._value}))
counts = union(tables: [full, kpm])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["rule"], columnKey: ["s"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, full: if exists r.full then r.full else 0, kpm: if exists r.kpm then r.kpm else 0}))
total = (column) => {
  found = counts |> sum(column: column) |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: column)
  return if length(arr: found) > 0 then found[0] else 0
}
missed = counts
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, d: if r.full > r.kpm then r.full - r.kpm else 0}))
  |> sum(column: "d")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "d")
present = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.env == "${kpm_only}")
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> group()
  |> count(column: "_measurement")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_measurement")
replayed = if length(arr: present) > 0 then present[0] > 0 else false
array.from(rows: [
  {항목: "1~4단계 경보", 값: total(column: "full")},
  {항목: "1단계만 경보", 값: if replayed then total(column: "kpm") else -1},
  {항목: "1단계만으로는 못 잡은 경보", 값: if not replayed then -1 else if length(arr: missed) > 0 then missed[0] else 0}])

panels.title: 단계 비교 — 룰별 경보 수
panels.description: 룰별로 1~4단계(데이터 출처)와 1단계만(단계 비교 대상)의 경보 수(raise). 2~4단계 룰은 1단계만에서 0이어야 하고, 막대 차이가 'UE 메시지로 더 잡은 것'. 1단계만 재생 결과가 없으면 1단계만 막대가 모두 0이다

panels.title: 룰 × 단계 × 종류
panels.description: 룰·단계·종류마다 경보 수와 끝난 모습. high까지 = 심각도가 high까지 오른 경보(27_ §5.3). 강제 종료 = end(분석 엔진 재시작·입력 끊김·입력 멈춤). 끝이 안 옴 = clear·end가 오지 않은 경보. 길이는 해제·강제 종료된 경보만

import "date"
import "strings"
alerts = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 1h, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and r.env == "${source}")

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({alert_id: r.alert_id, rule: r.rule, stage: r.stage, kind: r.kind, cell: r.cell, event: r.event,
      t: r._time, f: r._field, s: string(v: r._value), a: true}))
  |> group()
evidence = alerts |> filter(fn: (r) => false)
summary = union(tables: [alerts, evidence])
  |> group(columns: ["alert_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["t"])
  |> reduce(identity: {rule: "", stage: "", kind: "", cell: "", start: time(v: 0), last: time(v: 0), active: time(v: 0),
                       event: "", sev: 0, ues: "", rep: "", key: "", reason: "", n: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        rule: if r.a then r.rule else accumulator.rule,
        stage: if r.a then r.stage else accumulator.stage,
        kind: if r.a then r.kind else accumulator.kind,
        cell: if r.a then r.cell else accumulator.cell,
        start: if r.a and accumulator.n == 0 then r.t else accumulator.start,
        last: if r.a then r.t else accumulator.last,
        active: if r.t > accumulator.active then r.t else accumulator.active,
        event: if r.a then r.event else accumulator.event,
        sev: if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "high" then 2
             else if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "medium" and accumulator.sev < 1 then 1 else accumulator.sev,
        ues: if r.f == "ues_total" then r.s else accumulator.ues,
        rep: if r.f == "rep_value" then r.s else accumulator.rep,
        key: if r.f == "rep_key" then r.s else accumulator.key,
        reason: if r.f == "reason" then r.s else accumulator.reason,
        n: if r.a then accumulator.n + 1 else accumulator.n}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.n > 0)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      idle = int(v: now()) - int(v: r.active)
      limit = if r.stage == "1" then 15000000000 else 90000000000
      return {r with
        status: if r.event == "clear" then "해제" else if r.event == "end" then "강제 종료 (" + r.reason + ")"
                else if idle > limit then "상태 불명" else "열림",
        class: if r.kind == "attack" then "공격" else if strings.hasPrefix(v: r.rule, prefix: "AN-") then "이상 유형" else "판정 보류"}
    })

in_range = summary
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.start >= v.timeRangeStart and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
in_range
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, stage: r.stage, class: r.class,
      high: if r.sev == 2 then 1 else 0,
      cleared: if r.event == "clear" then 1 else 0,
      ended: if r.event == "end" then 1 else 0,
      open: if r.event == "raise" or r.event == "update" then 1 else 0,
      secs: if r.event == "clear" or r.event == "end" then float(v: int(v: r.last) - int(v: r.start)) / 1000000000.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["rule", "stage", "class"])
  |> reduce(identity: {n: 0, high: 0, cleared: 0, ended: 0, open: 0, secs: 0.0, longest: 0.0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({n: accumulator.n + 1, high: accumulator.high + r.high,
        cleared: accumulator.cleared + r.cleared, ended: accumulator.ended + r.ended, open: accumulator.open + r.open,
        secs: accumulator.secs + r.secs, longest: if r.secs > accumulator.longest then r.secs else accumulator.longest}))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({rule: r.rule, 룰: r.rule, 공격: r.rule, 단계: r.stage, 종류: r.class, "경보 수": r.n,
      "high까지": r.high, 해제: r.cleared, "강제 종료": r.ended, "끝이 안 옴": r.open,
      "평균 길이(초)": if r.cleared + r.ended > 0 then r.secs / float(v: r.cleared + r.ended) else 0.0,
      "최대 길이(초)": r.longest}))
  |> sort(columns: ["경보 수"], desc: true)

panels.description: 해제 = clear(조건이 풀림). 강제 종료 = end — 분석 엔진 재시작(session_reset)·입력 끊김(input_lost)·입력 멈춤(input_silent)(27_ §5.1). 끝이 안 옴 = clear·end가 오지 않은 경보(아직 열려 있거나 탐지 엔진이 끝을 못 보냄)

targets.query:
import "array"
import "date"
import "strings"
alerts = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 1h, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and r.env == "${source}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "severity" or r._field == "ues_total" or r._field == "rep_value"
      or r._field == "rep_key" or r._field == "reason")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({alert_id: r.alert_id, rule: r.rule, stage: r.stage, kind: r.kind, cell: r.cell, event: r.event,
      t: r._time, f: r._field, s: string(v: r._value), a: true}))
  |> group()
evidence = alerts |> filter(fn: (r) => false)
summary = union(tables: [alerts, evidence])
  |> group(columns: ["alert_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["t"])
  |> reduce(identity: {rule: "", stage: "", kind: "", cell: "", start: time(v: 0), last: time(v: 0), active: time(v: 0),
                       event: "", sev: 0, ues: "", rep: "", key: "", reason: "", n: 0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        rule: if r.a then r.rule else accumulator.rule,
        stage: if r.a then r.stage else accumulator.stage,
        kind: if r.a then r.kind else accumulator.kind,
        cell: if r.a then r.cell else accumulator.cell,
        start: if r.a and accumulator.n == 0 then r.t else accumulator.start,
        last: if r.a then r.t else accumulator.last,
        active: if r.t > accumulator.active then r.t else accumulator.active,
        event: if r.a then r.event else accumulator.event,
        sev: if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "high" then 2
             else if r.f == "severity" and r.s == "medium" and accumulator.sev < 1 then 1 else accumulator.sev,
        ues: if r.f == "ues_total" then r.s else accumulator.ues,
        rep: if r.f == "rep_value" then r.s else accumulator.rep,
        key: if r.f == "rep_key" then r.s else accumulator.key,
        reason: if r.f == "reason" then r.s else accumulator.reason,
        n: if r.a then accumulator.n + 1 else accumulator.n}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.n > 0)
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      idle = int(v: now()) - int(v: r.active)
      limit = if r.stage == "1" then 15000000000 else 90000000000
      return {r with
        status: if r.event == "clear" then "해제" else if r.event == "end" then "강제 종료 (" + r.reason + ")"
                else if idle > limit then "상태 불명" else "열림",
        class: if r.kind == "attack" then "공격" else if strings.hasPrefix(v: r.rule, prefix: "AN-") then "이상 유형" else "판정 보류"}
    })

in_range = summary
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.start >= v.timeRangeStart and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
flags = in_range
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({alert_id: r.alert_id,
      cleared: if r.event == "clear" then 1 else 0,
      session_reset: if r.event == "end" and r.reason == "session_reset" then 1 else 0,
      input_lost: if r.event == "end" and r.reason == "input_lost" then 1 else 0,
      input_silent: if r.event == "end" and r.reason == "input_silent" then 1 else 0,
      open: if r.event == "raise" or r.event == "update" then 1 else 0}))
union(tables: [flags, array.from(rows: [{alert_id: "", cleared: 0, session_reset: 0, input_lost: 0, input_silent: 0, open: 0}])])
  |> group()
  |> reduce(identity: {cleared: 0, session_reset: 0, input_lost: 0, input_silent: 0, open: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({cleared: accumulator.cleared + r.cleared, session_reset: accumulator.session_reset + r.session_reset, input_lost: accumulator.input_lost + r.input_lost, input_silent: accumulator.input_silent + r.input_silent, open: accumulator.open + r.open}))
  |> rename(columns: {cleared: "해제", session_reset: "강제 종료 · 분석 엔진 재시작", input_lost: "강제 종료 · 입력 끊김", input_silent: "강제 종료 · 입력 멈춤", open: "끝이 안 옴"})

panels.title: 근거 손실
panels.description: 탐지 엔진 증거 큐(4,096줄)가 넘쳐 버린 근거가 있었나 — 해제·강제 종료된 경보의 evidence_sent·evidence_dropped 합(27_ §7). 판정은 멈추지 않지만 경보 상세의 근거 그래프가 빈다

targets.query:
import "array"
sums = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and (r._field == "evidence_sent" or r._field == "evidence_dropped")
      and r.env == "${source}" and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
total = (field) => {
  found = sums |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == field) |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
  return if length(arr: found) > 0 then found[0] else 0
}
sent = total(field: "evidence_sent")
dropped = total(field: "evidence_dropped")
array.from(rows: [{"보낸 근거": sent, "버린 근거": dropped,
  "손실률": if sent + dropped > 0 then float(v: dropped) / float(v: sent + dropped) * 100.0 else 0.0}])

panels.title: 입력 끊김 (gap)
panels.description: 경보 중 탐지 엔진 입력이 끊긴 구간(gap, 27_ §6.4)이 몇 번, 모두 몇 초였나. 그 구간의 근거는 비어 있다

targets.query:
import "array"
gaps = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gap" and r._field == "t_to" and r.env == "${source}" and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, ms: r._value - int(v: r._time) / 1000000}))
count = gaps |> count(column: "ms") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "ms")
total = gaps |> sum(column: "ms") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "ms")
array.from(rows: [{"gap 수": if length(arr: count) > 0 then count[0] else 0,
  "빠진 시간": if length(arr: total) > 0 then float(v: total[0]) / 1000.0 else 0.0}])

panels.title: 상시 KPM2 칸 채움
panels.description: 3초 칸 가운데 100 ms 원본을 다 채우지 못한 칸(n < agg_ms / 100, 27_ §4.1)이 얼마나 됐나. 분석 엔진 입력이 고르게 들어왔는지 본다. 상시 경로를 켠 실험에서만 나온다

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpm2" and r._field == "n" and r.env == "${source}" and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, part: if r._value * 100 < int(v: r.agg_ms) then 1 else 0}))
  |> reduce(identity: {cells: 0, part: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({cells: accumulator.cells + 1, part: accumulator.part + r.part}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with ratio: if r.cells > 0 then float(v: r.part) / float(v: r.cells) * 100.0 else 0.0}))
  |> rename(columns: {cells: "전체 칸", part: "칸 일부 없음", ratio: "비율"})

panels.title: 일부만 측정된 지표 (kpm2 partial)
panels.description: 3초 칸 안에서 값이 일부 칸에만 있었던 지표(kpm2 partial, 27_ §4.1)와 그런 칸의 수. 비어 있으면 모든 지표가 다 측정됨

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kpm2" and r._field == "partial_json" and r._value != "[]" and r.env == "${source}"
      and contains(value: r.cell, set: ${cell:json}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, 지표: r._value, 칸: 1}))
  |> group(columns: ["지표"])
  |> sum(column: "칸")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["칸"], desc: true)

panels.title: 탐지율 · 오탐 · 탐지 지연 · 수집 오버헤드
panels.description: 전체 파이프라인(분석 엔진 → 탐지 엔진 → 대시보드, 실제 공격)이 완성된 뒤 탐지 쪽과 정해 채운다(27_ §9)

options.content:
- **탐지율 · 오탐**: 정답 기록(공격 구간)과 경보를 맞추는 규칙 — 탐지 쪽과 정함(27_ §9 R1·R2)
- **탐지 지연**: 경보별 지연 — 27_ §9 R3
- **수집 오버헤드**: 노드별 호스트 CPU·메모리와 eBPF 에이전트 프로세스 몫 — 측정 형식 협의 중(27_ §9 R5)
